entities.page_title: Family Reunion Visa - German Missions in Pakistan
entities.title: How to apply for a family reunion visa
entities.summary: This page describes the process for applying for a German family reunion visa for family members joining a recognised refugee, a German citizen, or an EU citizen residing in Germany. It details required documents, language certificate exemptions, and appointment procedures for applicants in Pakistan.
eligibility: Applicant must be joining a spouse or family member residing in Germany
To apply for a spouse visa, both partners have to be at least 18 years old
Family members of recognised refugees must submit a timely notice ("fristwahrende Anzeige") within 3 months of recognition
required_documents: Application form (Videx)
One biometric passport photo of each applicant and reference person
Certificate of residency in Germany ("Meldebescheinigung") of spouse/family member
Copy of spouse's/family member's residence permit
Applicant's current passport and ID card (CNIC)
Copies of previous passports
Copies of spouse's/family member's valid and previous passports
Original NADRA computerized birth certificate
Original Nikah Nama (Urdu with English translation)
Original NADRA computerized marriage registration certificate
Proof of previous marriages for both spouses (if applicable)
Court order regarding legal guardianship (if applicable)
BAMF deed (if applicable)
Travel insurance policy valid for one year
A1 language certificate (with exemptions)
C1 language certificate (with exemptions)
Additional proof of name, birthday and relationship as a family
Appointment confirmation e-mail (for Islamabad applicants)
Applicant's declaration
Information regarding legal representation
application_process: Register at the appropriate visa section based on citizenship/residence (Afghanistan, Karachi for Sindh/Balochistan residents, or Islamabad)
Starting 15.01.2026, Islamabad applications only accepted via Consular Services Portal (www.digital.diplo.de)
Receive link to book appointment if application is in order
Attend appointment to show original documents, pay fee, and submit biometrics
Embassy may request additional documents or PKR 75,000 for document verification
entities.application_fee: 75 Euros for adults, 37.50 Euros for children 0-17, payable in PKR; no fee if joining a German or EU national
important_notes: Original documents including passports must be presented; travel passport remains at the mission during processing
All document copies must be DIN A4 size, complete, legible, and not stapled
Due to long waiting times, some documents may expire before application; recommended to obtain updated documents once appointment is confirmed
Registering on the waiting list does not count as a timely notice or visa application
entities.required_language_test: A1/C1 (Goethe-Institut, ÖSD, telc GmbH, or TestDaF)

extra_information.special_cases: Additional documents required if marrying in Germany or joining a non-German EU citizen
extra_information.document_verification_fee: PKR 75,000 if requested by the mission
